display_name: World inflation versus growth of total credit, 1988-2011 (Ramamurthy)

triage.reason: Faithful direct replication of book figure 15.13 - Ramamurthy's updated 38-country / 46-episode cross-section (Romania de-duplicated from the 39-entry footnote) extending Harberger to 1988-2011. Cross-sectional country panel; the single year label (2011) is correct and the COVERAGE_START prescreen flag is an index-axis false positive. Hyperinflation magnitudes verified (Armenia pi 23.12 = 2,312%) consistent with the book's note that the upper range is ten times higher than figure 15.12.

corrections: UNITS FIX: registry declared units 'rate_percent' but stored values are decimal fractions (1.0 = 100%). Brazil lambda 12.79 means 1,279% credit growth, Armenia pi 23.12 means 2,312% inflation - decimal, not percent. Both subseries are rate_decimal.
